lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered clusters of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with greater proximal density near the pectoral insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like architecture on the posterior half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank showing distinct highlight/shadow gradients, maintaining a parallel trajectory toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Irregular distribution of approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and upper distal region of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant depigmentation and abrasion on the distal tip of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal remoras attached to the pectoral fin and ventral midsection.
